query:
SELECT a.user_id, a.timezone FROM suggestion_audience a
               WHERE a.seen_at > $2
                 AND extract(hour FROM $1 AT TIME ZONE a.timezone)::int >= $4
                 AND extract(hour FROM $1 AT TIME ZONE a.timezone)::int < $5
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM suggestion_generation g
                     WHERE g.user_id = a.user_id
                       AND (g.status = 'generating' OR (g.trigger = 'nightly' AND g.started_at > $3)))
               ORDER BY a.seen_at
               LIMIT $6
